meta.title: Robopipe — Visual quality control that learns your product
meta.description: Robopipe puts deep-learning visual inspection across food, pharma, retail and logistics operations. Sealed IP67 camera, self-service training, live floor dashboard. Book a demo.

sections.headline: AI visual control that learns your product.
sections.subline: Robopipe puts deep-learning inspection wherever your products move — in food plants, pharma packaging, retail fulfilment and logistics hubs. Catch defects in real time. No data scientists required.

sections.eyebrow: Trusted in production and warehouses across Europe

sections.headline: Deep-learning inspection your own team runs.
sections.subline: AI defect detection built for the factory floor, not the lab.

items.title: Self-service setup
items.body: Add a new product to check yourself in minutes. Snap a few good examples, confirm what "right" looks like, and Robopipe starts inspecting — no engineers, no tickets, no waiting.

items.title: Real-time production monitoring
items.body: A floor display that shows operators how today's batch is running — piece counts, pass rate, top defects, downtime and takt, with instant feedback the team acts on right at the line.

items.title: Built for harsh environments
items.body: Fully sealed, IP67 washdown-ready hardware that survives steam, spray, dust and cold stores. Mount it straight above the line and hose it down with the rest of the plant.

items.title: Connects to anything
items.body: An optional versatile AI PLC controller with analog and digital I/O, RS485/RS232, Modbus and EtherCAT over Ethernet — wired into the systems you already run, including your ERP and WMS.

sections.headline: Made to redefine your industry.
sections.subline: The same pipeline — capture, label, train, infer — tuned to four very different floors.

items.title: Food processing
items.body: Defects, foreign objects and portion checks at line speed.

items.title: Pharma & healthcare
items.body: Fill, closure and label verification with full audit trails.

items.title: Retail & e-commerce
items.body: Product photos tagged by AI — catalogs that stay searchable.

items.title: Logistics
items.body: Safety hazards flagged live, movements turned into statistics.

sections.headline: AI inspection, live in a day.
sections.subline: No integrators, no long projects. Your team owns it from day one.

steps.title: We install on-site
steps.body: Our team comes to your plant or warehouse, mounts the sealed camera over your line and sets everything up on the spot — wet, cold and dusty areas included.

steps.title: Add your product
steps.body: Capture a batch of images, label them and train the model — guided end to end, no ML expertise needed. You stay in control of what passes.

steps.title: Go live — with support
steps.body: Operators see quality on the floor display; managers watch trends in the analytics portal. We stay on with post-install service whenever you need us.

sections.quote: “The floor team finally sees their quality score live — and quality went up because of it. We were shown how to label one product; the rest we add ourselves.”

items.question: Can we add new products ourselves?
items.answer: Yes. Adding a product is self-service — show it a few good examples and it starts checking. No engineers or vendor visits needed.

items.question: Will it survive our washdown area?
items.answer: The hardware is IP67-rated and fully sealed for steam, spray and cold stores.

items.question: What do operators actually see?
items.answer: A live floor dashboard with today's pass rate, top defects and instant feedback.

items.question: How long until we're inspecting?
items.answer: Most lines are live within a day — mount, add your product, go.
